author: Praxis VI
title: Diagnostics (test): PC-variance uniformity — Praxis frozen vs Mono log1p PBVE-lite (1500/2000 HVG)
abstract: Compares per‑PC variance uniformity, per‑batch dispersion, and covariance off‑diagonal magnitude on X_emb across three methods on Heart: (i) Praxis frozen MPB‑GraphFWPCA+DAQB; (ii) monolithic log1p PBVE‑lite with 1500 HVGs; (iii) monolithic log1p PBVE‑lite with 2000 HVGs. Prints JSON blocks.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
import anndata as ad

sys.path.extend(['storage/praxis'])
from mpb_graphfwpca_override import eliminate_mpb_graphfwpca as run_praxis
from monolithic_log1p_pbve import eliminate_batch_effect_fn as run_mono_pbve
from diag_pc_uniformity import summarize_embedding

PRAXIS_CFG = dict(lam_override=0.605, delta=0.12, kdensity=22, k_total=50, emb_n_neighbors=17, gamma_max=0.70, cap=2.0, rng_seed=0)

def _run_and_summarize(adata, fn, cfg):
    B = fn(adata.copy(), **cfg) if cfg else fn(adata.copy())
    stats = summarize_embedding(B, obsm_key="X_emb", batch_key="batch")
    return stats

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
    # Praxis frozen baseline
    praxis = _run_and_summarize(adata, run_praxis, PRAXIS_CFG)
    print("UNIFORMITY_PRAXIS_JSON:", json.dumps(praxis))

    # Mono log1p PBVE-lite — 1500 HVGs
    mono1500 = _run_and_summarize(adata, run_mono_pbve, {"n_hvg": 1500, "n_pcs": 60})
    print("UNIFORMITY_MONO1500_JSON:", json.dumps(mono1500))

    # Mono log1p PBVE-lite — 2000 HVGs
    mono2000 = _run_and_summarize(adata, run_mono_pbve, {"n_hvg": 2000, "n_pcs": 60})
    print("UNIFORMITY_MONO2000_JSON:", json.dumps(mono2000))

    return "Uniformity comparison completed"
